item.name: Akamai API Security Modify the Action for a Reputation Profile

request.name: Akamai API Security Modify the Action for a Reputation Profile

description.content: Update what action to take when reputation profile's rule triggers. Use `alert` to record the trigger of the event, `deny` to block the request, or `none` to take no action. Currently the only member in the reputation profile object is `action`. _Products:_ Kona Site Defender, App & API Protector with the Advanced Security module.
